observed.caption: A calm lake in a busy urban park with people along the shores and boating, framed by large trees and tall city buildings reflected in the water under an overcast sky.
observed.description: The image shows an outdoor urban park centered on a calm lake that reflects the cloudy sky and tall buildings behind it. In the foreground a grassy bank with a narrow dirt edge curves along the water, with two people standing on the left shore near the water's edge and a large leafy tree overhanging from the left and a large dense green tree on the right. Across the lake, many small figures of people are scattered along the far grassy shore, some sitting and some standing, and a small red boat with several occupants floats on the water toward the right. Behind the far shore a line of mature trees separates the park from several tall beige high-rise buildings with antennas and additional smaller city buildings, all under a bright overcast sky.
